Subject: Re: Postpay metering exception — audit outcome and credit proposal

Hi Aisha / Chris — thanks for the patience while we completed the investigation. Summary and resolution below:

Summary of findings
- Root cause: ~88% of the measured spike aligns with Brightlane’s client-side retry rollout (confirmed by matching request IDs).
- Platform-side duplicates: we identified 112 server-side duplicated receipts that did not have corresponding client retries; these were traced to a brief routing retry in frontend shard f-12 during 2027-10-17 21:05–21:07 UTC (internal incident INF-2027-847).
- Total affected tokens (server-identified duplicates only): 1,740,000 tokens.

Resolution proposed
- Goodwill credit: Redwood will apply a credit equal to the cost of the platform-side duplicated tokens (1,740,000 tokens) at the postpay unit rate for October. This will be reflected as a negative line on INV-202710-BL-57.
- Invoice hold: we held collection on the disputed portion while we validated. Final invoice (INV-202710-BL-57) has been adjusted; the revised invoice PDF is attached.
- Process changes: we’ve deployed a frontend dedup filter for immediate mitigation and added a replay-detection alert to reduce recurrence.

Next steps / asks
- Please confirm receipt of the adjusted invoice and whether the credit amount looks correct to you. If so, we’ll finalize accounting and mark the case closed.
- Naomi, I’d appreciate a quick renewal touchpoint once Brightlane confirms.

Attachments: proposed-credit-calculation.xlsx, invoice-202710-BL-57.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Billing & Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
